symptom: Comparison Table page crashes with AttributeError: 'Styler' object has no attribute 'applymap' on pandas 2.1+
rootcause: app.py:584 uses df.style.applymap() which was removed in pandas 2.1 and replaced by df.style.map()
fix: Change df.style.applymap(_style_cell, ...) to df.style.map(_style_cell, ...) in app.py:584
